The '''Mabari armor''', also known as '''Mabari armorweave''' or '''Mabari steelweave''', was a type of [[Armor/Legends|armor]] created by the [[Mabari/Legends|Mabari]].

==Description==
[[File:ZamWesell-DaG.png|thumb|left|180px|[[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]] wearing Mabari armorweave.]]
The Mabari armor offered a high degree of protection against energy-based weapons like [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] but lesser protection from kinetic damage.<ref name="SWG:CU" /> The complete armor set consisted of helmet, chest plate, gloves, belt, pants and boots. The leggings included a metal [[Kama/Legends|kama]]-style skirt. The armor was available in several colors.<ref name="SWG" />

The Mabari armor was similar in appearance to [[Jal Shey Advisor armor|Jal Shey]] and [[Zeison Sha Warrior armor|Zeison Sha armored robe]].<ref name="TSL">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref>

==History==
The Mabari steelweave was developed by the [[Mabari/Legends|Mabari]], an ancient order of warrior knights<ref name="SWGTCG">{{SWGTCG|set=Squadrons Over Corellia|cardname=Mabari Steelweave Chest Plate}}</ref> from [[Zolan/Legends|Zolan]].<ref name="TCSWE" />

The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]] wore a Mabari armor during the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]].<ref name="TCSWE" /> In addition, a number of bounty hunters affiliated with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] used to wear this kind of armor during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="GB:CC">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Clone Campaigns]]''</ref>

By the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Mabari armors were mainly used by [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]]. Following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], [[Ree-Yees/Legends|Ree-Yees]] offered a Mabari steelweave to a spacer who achieved several missions for him and [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]].<ref name="SWG" /> Around the same time, a trader encountered the [[Sanyassan Marauders/Legends|Sanyassan Marauder]] [[armorsmith]] [[Macchbraus]] on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]]. Macchbraus requested the trader to craft him [[Bone armor|bone]], [[Composite armor|composite]], [[Padded armor/Legends|padded]] and Mabari armors in exchange for teaching him to create [[Marauder Assault Armor|Marauder]] [[Marauder Reconnaissance Armor|armors]].<ref name="SWG:GU5">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other|Game Update 5}}</ref>
